  name: Noncompliant Device Report
  description: Generates a report of managed devices that are noncompliant and advises admins on next steps.

  minAppVersion: 0.1.0

    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices

skills:
  - id: load_managed_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load Managed Devices
    detail: Retrieves managed devices from Microsoft Graph.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - complianceState
        - userPrincipalName
        - lastSyncDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All

    format: llm
    label: Summarize Noncompliant Devices
    detail: Uses the LLM to analyze loaded devices and produce a concise report.

      system: |

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: top-noncompliant-models
  name: Top Noncompliant Models
  description: Lists the oldest 10 managed devices and summarizes compliance by model.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load managed devices
    detail: Retrieves managed devices with compliance and sync information.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - model
        - complianceState
        - lastSyncDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All
  - id: count_by_compliance
    format: transform
    label: Count devices by complianceState
    detail: Tallies devices per complianceState bucket.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: complianceState
      buckets:
        - compliant
        - noncompliant
        - unknown
  - id: sort_by_last_sync
    format: transform
    label: Sort devices by lastSyncDateTime
    detail: Orders devices by lastSyncDateTime ascending and keeps the oldest 10.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: lastSyncDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize results
    detail: Generates a short compliance report.
    settings:
      system: You are a Microsoft 365 compliance assistant.
      prompt: |
        Based on the following data, write a concise report:
        - Total devices: {{ load_devices.output | length }}
        - Compliance counts: {{ count_by_compliance.output }}
        - Oldest 10 devices: {{ sort_by_last_sync.output }}
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 200
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
  result:
    summary: "{{ summarize.output }}"
    data:
      totalDevices: "{{ load_devices.output | length }}"
      complianceCounts: "{{ count_by_compliance.output }}"
      oldestDevices: "{{ sort_by_last_sync.output }}"
```
